scope: Caller read-only targeted validation of six already-confirmed ce-code-review findings; this does not replace or rerun the completed actual review.

perFinding.evidence: Actual signed UI lost-B/equal-revision-C probe retains C in transient document and persisted conversation. Unsubmitted conversion restarts after changed unsigned draft. Already-submitted conversion replays identical destination/request/body and retains later signed draft in both modes.

Actual signed STORAGE_LIMIT/413 and INVALID_INPUT/400 material-count probes allow corrected fresh request and exactly one saved row. Independent 12-case UI status matrix resets only these exact pairs; network, unreadable response, 5xx, auth, conflict/request-reuse and 404 retain exact submitted body.

Current pending composer fields, signed material wrapper and manual draft are in separate local export annotations. Canonical document/proof are unchanged, new local annotations have no model, archive includes no token or token secret.
Independent actual demo recipe VM captures only current edited letter or current clarification. Instructions and version panel text remain excluded.
Extractor negative description repairs on second call or rejects after two. Actual signed handler failed repair returns AI_OUTPUT_INVALID/422 with no material, no proof and no conversation writes.

Verbatim emotional visible text succeeds unchanged beside objective description in direct extractor and actual signed handler. Only description receives certainty guard; ordinary OCR still preserves identical raw text.

priorProvenance: Existing exact-draft/source-version and old-signed-provenance tests pass without rewriting original versions.
limits: Synthetic providers and in-memory storage only; root runs full suite and browser separately. No external APIs, deployment, production data, staging or commits performed.
